data.title: Ellington Cove
data.about:
Ellington Cove at Dubai Islands by Ellington Properties is an exciting new development offering the perfect blend of luxury and convenience, with a range of residences from studios to 3-bedroom apartments, 3-bedroom deluxe units, and 4-bedroom penthouses. Nestled in a prime beachfront location, this project comprises two parts, Ellington Cove I and Ellington Cove II, each featuring two towers: Tower A and Tower B.

Residents will enjoy stunning sea views and the vibrant lifestyle that Dubai is known for. Luxury living in Dubai’s most prestigious waterfront developments is the essence of this project, with world-class amenities and beautifully designed residences enhancing the experience. Ellington Cove Dubai Islands is just minutes away from a world-class golf course, a modern shopping mall, and a bustling marina with numerous restaurants and entertainment options. Whether you seek relaxation or adventure, Dubai Islands provides it all.

characteristics_module.title: Ellington Cove at Dubai Islands: Where Homes Echo the Rhythm of the Waves!
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Exclusive Beachfront Living: Enjoy direct and private access to pristine beaches, offering Dubai's rare and sought-after coastal lifestyle.
  • Stunning Sea Views: All residences feature unobstructed, breathtaking sea views, creating a tranquil, luxurious atmosphere for residents.
  • Prime Location: Just minutes away from world-class golf courses, high-end shopping malls, gourmet restaurants, and vibrant entertainment along the marina.
  • Wide Range of Residences: Offering luxury studios, 1–3 bedroom apartments, 3-bedroom deluxe units, and 4-bedroom penthouses, catering to diverse living preferences.
  • Low-Rise Luxury Buildings: Thoughtfully designed low-rise structures ensure privacy, spaciousness, and a close-knit, community-focused environment.
  • Luxury Living in a Prestigious Waterfront Development: A combination of world-class amenities, beautifully designed residences, and a prime location make Dubai Islands the epitome of waterfront luxury.

location_tile.title: Dubai Islands: A Premier Coastal Destination
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Dubai Islands, formerly known as Deira Islands, is an iconic waterfront destination located along Dubai's northern coastline. Perfectly positioned just a short drive from Downtown Dubai, Dubai International Airport, and other key landmarks, this dynamic community offers unparalleled connectivity while providing a serene escape from the city's hustle. Surrounded by pristine beaches and crystal-clear waters, Dubai Islands are envisioned as a hub for luxury living, world-class hospitality, and vibrant leisure experiences, making it an ideal choice for both residents and investors.

  • 15 Minutes - Dubai International Airport 
  • 20 Minutes - Dubai Heritage Village
  • 15 Minutes - Waterfront Market
  • 25 Minutes - Downtown Dubai
  • 25 Minutes - Dubai Festival City
